items.name: Wave 0 no-edge gate
items.criterion: flat P&L exactly 0 with and without costs; no-cost always-on |t| <= 3; with-cost always-on negative and below no-cost; random bleeds fastest

items.name: Cost, fill and margin model
items.criterion: for every scripted seller: costed P&L equals free P&L minus what was charged, per seed; a cash settlement charges nothing; no structure leaves the book unpaid
items.evidence: 4 sellers, 100 episodes each; measured drag matches prediction to 0.00 dollars

items.name: Data adapter boundary
items.criterion: every available source clears the provider contract and the structural invariants; an unavailable source reports SKIPPED and never PASS

items.name: Leak detection suite
items.criterion: no observation field at t predicts the true return into t+1 at a Bonferroni-adjusted alpha; every field in OBS_NAMES is tested under the probe or records why not; every field has a positive control that fires
items.evidence: 630 pairs over 10 seeds; 13 of 14 fields tested, untested: atm_iv; all 14 controls fire and are attributed correctly

items.name: Leak detection floor
items.criterion: the smallest planted leak the detector still catches is recorded
items.evidence: grid (1.0, 0.5, 0.25, 0.1, 0.05), caught (True, True, True, True, False), floor eps = 0.1

items.name: Run artifacts and manifests
items.criterion: every run writes a hashed manifest with config, commit, seed and package versions; a manifest missing any required field is refused, not written
items.evidence: run_id adddb0b7e5f604ad-s1, git c9de9fd5, 7 versions recorded; an unknown commit is refused

items.name: Throughput, measured
items.criterion: the schedule uses a measured steps/s figure for the steady-state workload, not the document's unvalidated 500-3,000 estimate
items.evidence: 1,865 steps/s/core over 20,034 steps (always_on); 2,231 steps/s under random

items.name: PPO-inclusive throughput
items.criterion: the training-update arm reports a measured steps/s figure at the fixed hyperparameters of decision D3, so the sweep budget covers training
items.evidence: 1,016 steps/s/core over 20,000 steps; the update is 54% of wall clock against the 2,231 steps/s random arm
